episode.title: Learned the Hard Way — Docker Bind Mounts & Data Protection

content.summary_short: Operational lesson on protecting bind-mounted data and recognizing unsafe container starts.
content.start_here: Open the Docker Bind Mounts & Data Protection lesson.

lesson.objective: Recognize Docker bind-mount failure modes and apply preflight checks before container startup.
lesson.why_it_matters: A missing host path can silently create an empty directory and make real data appear lost.
lesson.apply: Use the preflight checklist before starting a bind-mounted service.
lesson.advance: Carry the never-start checks into NXCore service work.
